name: Belite Bio, Inc
summary: Belite Bio, Inc, a clinical stage biopharmaceutical drug development company, engages in the research and development of novel therapeutics with unmet medical needs in the United States. Its lead product candidate is Tinlarebant (LBS-008), an orally administered, which is in phase 3 clinical trial as an early intervention for maintaining the health and integrity of retinal tissues in stargardt disease type 1 and geographic atrophy patients. The company also develops LBS-009, an retinol binding protein 4 oral therapy, which is in preclinical development targeting liver disease, including non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, nonalcoholic steatohepatitis, and type 2 diabetes, as well as gout.
